verses.text: No man whose private parts have been crushed or cut off may join the assembly of the LORD.
No one born from a forbidden marriage may join the assembly of the LORD. None of their descendants may join it, even down to the tenth generation.
No Ammonite or Moabite may join the assembly of the LORD. None of their descendants may ever join it, even down to the tenth generation.
For they did not come to meet you with food and water on your journey after you left Egypt. They also hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Mesopotamia to put a curse on you.
But the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam. Instead, the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.
As long as you live, never try to help them have peace or success.
Do not hate an Edomite, because Edomites are your relatives. Do not hate an Egyptian, because you lived as foreigners in their land.
The third generation of children born to them may join the assembly of the LORD.
When you are camped to fight your enemies, keep away from anything that would make you unclean.
If one of your men becomes unclean because of something that happened to him during the night, he must go outside the camp and stay there.
But as evening comes he must wash himself with water, and at sunset he may come back into the camp.
Have a place outside the camp where you can go to the toilet.
Carry a small shovel along with your weapons. When you go to the toilet, dig a hole with it, and then cover up your waste.
For the LORD your God moves around in your camp to protect you and to hand your enemies over to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see anything unclean among you and turn away from you.
If a slave runs away from his master and comes to you for safety, do not hand him back to his master.
Let him live among you in any town he chooses, wherever he likes best. Do not treat him badly.
No Israelite man or woman may become a temple prostitute.
Do not bring the money earned by a female or male prostitute into the house of the LORD your God to pay any promise, because the LORD your God hates them both.
Do not charge your fellow Israelite interest on a loan, whether it is money, food, or anything else that can earn interest.
You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a fellow Israelite. Then the LORD your God will bless you in everything you do in the land you are going in to take over.
If you make a promise to the LORD your God, do not be slow to keep it, because the LORD your God will certainly expect it from you, and you will be guilty of sin if you do not keep it.
But if you choose not to make a promise, you will not be guilty.
Be sure to do whatever you said you would do. You freely made your promise to the LORD your God with your own mouth, so you must keep it.
When you go into your neighbour's vineyard, you may eat as many grapes as you want, but do not put any in your basket.
When you go into your neighbour's grain field, you may pick some heads of grain with your hand, but do not cut their grain with a sickle.
